# hextimator

> One brand color in. A complete, accessible light + dark theme out.
> Use it programmatically (`hextimate(color)`) or via CLI (`npx hextimator`).

Generates palettes in **OKLCH** for perceptually even contrast; outputs map to sRGB with gamut mapping. WCAG contrast targets are configurable (`AAA` default).

## Pick a path

- **Got a color, want a stylesheet?** - CLI (section 1)
- **Got a color, want JSON / programmatic access?** - Library (section 2)
- **Building a React app?** - React (section 3)
- **Need a specific framework's tokens?** - Presets (section 4)

## 1. CLI

```bash
npx hextimator <color> [--preset <name>]... [-f|--format <as>] [-c|--colors <space>] [-o|--output <path>]
# alias:
npx hextimate <color> [same options]
```

Quote hex colors in the shell (`'#6366f1'`).

### Common flags

| Flag | Meaning | Default |
|------|---------|---------|
| `-p`, `--preset` | Preset name, **repeatable** in order (`muted` then `shadcn`, etc.) | - |
| `-f`, `--format` | `css`, `object`, `tailwind`, `tailwind-css`, `scss`, `json` | `css` |
| `-c`, `--colors` | `hex`, `rgb`, `hsl`, `oklch`, `p3` (+ `-raw` variants) | `hex` |
| `-t`, `--theme` | `light`, `dark`, `both` (ignored for `css` / `tailwind-css`) | `both` |
| `-o`, `--output` | Write file instead of stdout | stdout |
| `--dark-mode` | `media`, `class`, `data-attribute`, `off` (stylesheet formats only) | `media` |
| `--selector` | Root selector for CSS output | `:root` |
| `--separator` | Between role and variant in token names | `-` |
| `--key-prefix` | For `object` / `json`; use `--` for CSS-like keys | (empty) |
| `--exclude-role`, `--exclude-variant` | Omit by internal name (repeatable) | - |
| `--min-contrast` | `AAA`, `AA`, or number | `AAA` |

### Style / semantics (CLI mirrors library `style`)

`--surface-color`, `--surface-hue-shift`, `--hue-shift`, `--surface-max-chroma`, `--fg-max-chroma`, `--light-lightness`, `--light-base-lightness-range`, `--light-max-chroma`, `--dark-lightness`, `--dark-base-lightness-range`, `--dark-max-chroma`, `--base-lightness-range`, `--invert-dark` (needs `--surface-color`), `--positive`, `--negative`, `--caution`.

### CVD (optional)

`--simulate <protanopia|deuteranopia|tritanopia|achromatopsia>`, `--adapt <same>`, `--cvd-severity 0..1`.

### Custom roles / variants

- `--role name=#RRGGBB` (repeatable)
- `--variant name:from:edge` or `name:between:a,b` (repeatable)

### Examples

```bash
npx hextimator '#6366f1'
npx hextimator '#6366f1' -f css -c oklch -o theme.css
npx hextimator '#6366f1' --preset shadcn
npx hextimator '#6366f1' --preset muted --preset shadcn
npx hextimator '#22aa44' --role cta=#ee2244 --variant hover:from:strong -o out.css
```

## 2. Library

```bash
npm install hextimator
```

```typescript
import { hextimate } from "hextimator";

const tokens = hextimate("#6366f1").format();
// { light: { accent, "accent-strong", ... }, dark: { ... } }

const sheet = hextimate("#6366f1").format({ as: "css", colors: "oklch" });
```

### Builder (chainable)

| Call | Role |
|------|------|
| `.preset(p)` | Apply preset(s); call multiple times, later wins on conflicts |
| `.style(partial)` | Merge `HextimateStyleOptions` (contrast, surfaces, semantics, etc.) |
| `.addRole` / `.addVariant` / `.addToken` | Extend the palette |
| `.fork(color?)` | Clone for another brand / tenant |
| `.simulate` / `.adaptFor` | CVD preview / adaptation |
| `.format(opts?)` | Output |

### `.format` highlights

| `as` | Result |
|------|--------|
| `object` | `{ light, dark }` flat maps |
| `css` | Single stylesheet string |
| `tailwind` | Nested `{ role: { DEFAULT, strong, ... } }` per side |
| `tailwind-css` | Tailwind v4 `@theme` string |
| `scss` / `json` | As named |

`colors`, `darkMode` (`"media"` \| `"class"` \| `"data-attribute"` \| `false`), `selector`, `roleNames`, `variantNames`, `separator`, `keyPrefix`, `excludeRoles`, `excludeVariants` match the CLI conceptually.

### Default token grid

Roles: `surface`, `accent`, `positive`, `negative`, `caution`. Variants: default (no suffix), `strong`, `weak`, `foreground`. Plus `brand-exact` and `brand-exact-foreground`.

### Utilities

`parseColor`, `convertColor`, `simulateColor`, `daltonizeColor` are exported from `hextimator`.

### Color inputs

Hex (with or without `#`), CSS `rgb` / `hsl`, `[r,g,b]` tuple, numeric `0xRRGGBB`. Alpha ignored.

## 3. React

```typescript
import { useHextimator } from "hextimator/react";
import { hextimate, presets } from "hextimator";

useHextimator("#6366f1", {
  presets: [presets.muted, presets.shadcn],
  darkMode: { type: "class" }, // optional: media | class | data | media-or-class | false
});
```

For app-wide state and palette switching: `HextimatorProvider`, `useHextimatorTheme` from `hextimator/react`.

**SSR:** `HextimatorStyle` injects `<style>` without waiting for effects; use optional `selector` to scope.

**Subtree themes:** `HextimatorScope` inherits shape from parent via `fork()` when nested.

React options align with `.style()`, `.preset()` / `presets[]`, `.format()` (output is CSS variables).

## 4. Presets

Import: `import { hextimate, presets } from "hextimator"`.

| Name | Kind | Notes |
|------|------|--------|
| `shadcn` | Framework | shadcn/ui-style CSS variables; pairs well with `as: "css"`, `colors: "oklch"` |
| `mui` | Framework | MUI-shaped token tree; often `colors: "hex"` |
| `muted` | Style | Lower chroma |
| `vibrant` | Style | Higher chroma / complementary neutrals |
| `tinted` | Style | Neutrals follow accent hue |
| `bold` | Style | Stronger accents, higher chroma on neutrals |

```typescript
hextimate("#6366f1").preset(presets.muted).preset(presets.shadcn).format();
```

Custom presets are plain objects (`style`, `roles`, `variants`, `tokens`, `format`); see repo docs linked below.

## Tailwind CSS v4

```css
@import "tailwindcss";
@import "hextimator/tailwind.css";
```

Registers utilities for built-in token names (`bg-accent`, etc.). Custom or preset-only names may need CLI-generated CSS.

## Fallback before JS

```css
@import "hextimator/fallback.css";
```

Neutral placeholders for **default** `hextimate()` variable names only. Does not cover preset-specific names (generate those with the CLI).
